title: Writing for different media
slide_intent: Teach a writer to adapt length, rhythm and emphasis to the place where a reader meets the message.
strategic_value: Sheffield Museums can speak in a recognizable voice across a web listing, a print feature and a social post while giving each reader an appropriate route to act.
demonstration: The page compares Website, Print and Social under numbered headings. The social guidance extends into the fourth column.
practical_value: Use scannable paragraphs and a call to action online, develop an intriguing angle in print and introduce a guest speaker clearly on social channels.

content_islands.name: Website and print
content_islands.spec: Set the two guidance blocks in adjacent columns. Explain scanning and links for web, and space for depth or playfulness in print.

content_islands.name: Social writing
content_islands.spec: Give the longer social guidance the remaining columns. Group advice about informal address, emphasis, emoji and identifying contributors.
